import collections,datetime,hashlib,json,math,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import onnx
root=Path('/Users/justinc/Documents/GitHub/onnax')
run=Path('/tmp/onnax-fused-final')
bench=Path('/tmp/onnax-fused-acceptance')
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text())
def digest(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def guard(p):
 r=read(p/'execution.json')
 assert r['status']=='complete' and r['returncode']==0 and r['temporary_files_removed']
 observations=r.pop('observations')
 r['physical_footprint_peak_bytes']=max(x['peak_bytes'] for x in observations)
 r['worker_log_sha256']=digest(p/'worker.log')
 return r
training={}
for precision in ['fp32','bf16']:
 r=read(run/precision/'report.json')
 assert r['steps']==100 and r['fused_ops'] and r['frozen_buffers_unchanged']
 assert r['requested_audits']['strict_reference']
 for a in r['audits']:
  assert all(a[k] for k in ['strict_loss_check_passed','strict_logit_check_passed','strict_gradient_check_passed'])
 for key in ['fixed_training_loss','validation_loss']:
  assert all(math.isfinite(x) for x in r[key]) and r[key][1]<r[key][0]
 counts=collections.Counter(n.op_type for n in onnx.load(run/precision/'export/forward.onnx').graph.node)
 assert {'Attention','RMSNormalization','RotaryEmbedding','Swish'} <= counts.keys()
 training[precision]={'report':r,'execution':guard(run/(precision+'.guard')),'retained_forward_operators':dict(counts),'exported_module_sha256':{p.name:digest(p) for p in sorted((run/precision/'export').glob('*.onnx'))}}
replay=read(run/'replay.json')
assert all(replay[k] for k in ['adapter_bitwise_equal','optimizer_bitwise_equal','scheduler_equal','frozen_hashes_equal','export_load_outputs_bitwise_equal','export_load_loss_gradients_bitwise_equal'])
measurements={}
for name in ['4k-decomposed','4k-fused','4k-fused-reviewed']:
 r=read(bench/(name+'.json'))
 assert r['samples']==3 and r['warmup']==1 and len(r['losses'])==4
 assert all(math.isfinite(x) for x in r['losses'])
 measurements[name]={'report':r,'execution':guard(bench/(name+'.guard'))}
a=measurements['4k-decomposed']['report'];b=measurements['4k-fused-reviewed']['report']
for key in ['input_ids_sha256','sequence','batch','head_chunk_size','checkpoint_layers','parameter_bytes','library_sha256','projection_precision','versions','threads','hardware','decoder_storage_bytes','valid_shifted_tokens','weight_values','base_storage','gradient_and_optimizer_dtype','ort_optimizer','mlx_compile_disabled','mlx_memory_limit_bytes','cpu_fallback_disabled']:
 assert a[key]==b[key],key
np.testing.assert_allclose(a['losses'],b['losses'],rtol=1e-6,atol=1e-6)
files=[*root.glob('src/onnax/**/*.py'),*root.glob('examples/huggingface/*.py'),*root.glob('examples/lora/*.py')]
result={'version':1,'created_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'reviewed_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip(),'source_sha256':{str(p.relative_to(root)):digest(p) for p in sorted(files)},'training':training,'recovery':{'report':replay,'execution':guard(run/'fp32-resume.guard')},'context_4096':measurements,'measurement_scope':{'warmup_updates':1,'timed_updates':3,'timing_selection':'Reviewed fused build at bcb373f; initial fused smoke retained separately','process_memory':'macOS kernel peak physical footprint includes construction, host arrays and native runtime','mlx_allocator_limit_bytes':20*1024**3,'idle_cache_limit_environment':None,'native_compilation':'disabled','ort_graph_optimizer':'disabled','optimizer':'External CPU FP32 AdamW','data':'Same pinned 4096-token input in all three runs'},'local_full_suite':{'passed':2470,'skipped':65,'existing_failure':{'test':'tests/test_qwen_bf16.py::test_qwen_bf16_forward_gradients_and_updates[fp32-storage-False]','assertion':'step 5: model.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj.lora.A parameter','runtime':'ONNX ReferenceEvaluator versus PyTorch','baseline_reproduction_commit':'02d2311','same_failure_on_baseline':True}},'publication_script':Path(__file__).read_text()}
output=root/'examples/huggingface/reports/qwen3-fused-operators-m1max.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
print(output,output.stat().st_size)
for name,entry in measurements.items():
 r=entry['report'];print(name,r['timings_ms']['step'],r['physical_footprint']['lifetime_peak_bytes']/1024**3,sum(r['nodes'].values()))
